name: aip1-skillcoach-huawei
description: Skill Coach — a learn-by-doing (deliberate practice) coach: pick any skill and get a personalized 6-day micro-program of daily tasks with clear done-criteria, progress tracking and difficulty feedback. Self-contained web app + Capacitor (huawei build). Works offline with built-in skill programs; optional user-supplied AI key/endpoint generates a custom program for any skill.
